name: Credential Capture via Reverse Proxy
description: Scoped authorized credential-capture playbook: operator deploys the FORGE reverse-proxy transport inside the ROE-authorized perimeter, routes a target login URL through the proxy, and captures the resulting credentials and MFA session cookies encrypted at rest under FORGE_ENGAGEMENT_KEY. Requires the scope manifest to grant the `reverse_proxy` permission block and an explicit written ROE reference. The playbook never auto-starts; the operator reviews the manifest, approves the capture target, and runs the capture through the audited CLI. All captured material is treated as evidence, never exported in plain text.
